title: Comindex S.A.
content:
Comindex is a specialty materials distributor serving the Iberian market with additives and performance materials, now part of the Swiss IMPAG Group. The company distributes aerogel products for coatings, construction, and insulation-related applications.

  • Coverage Area: Spain, Portugal, and Morocco
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel additives for paints, coatings, insulation materials, and construction formulations
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://www.impag.com/en (IMPAG Group)
review_notes: 2026-08-30 verified: comindex.es SSL certificate expired — original site no longer maintained after IMPAG Group acquisition (Swiss specialty chemicals distributor, verified 2026-08); website link now points to parent IMPAG Group.
